description.fun: Every flap of Moltres's flaming wings sheds embers in a brilliant flash, a sight said to have inspired the legend of the phoenix. It heals itself by dipping into the magma of an active volcano, and it arrives from the south with the spring, bringing warmth early to cold lands. Its name blends 'molten' with the Spanish 'tres': the third of Kanto's legendary birds, the one for spring.
description.guide: A large, yellow, flame-winged Fire and Flying Legendary Pokémon, one of Kanto's three legendary birds alongside Articuno and Zapdos. It is said to have inspired the legend of the phoenix. Its Galarian form, from The Crown Tundra, is Dark and Flying.
description.tagline: A legendary bird of flame that brings the spring

description.fun: Galar's Moltres blazes with a sinister, magenta energy so oppressive that most Pokémon can't even approach it. Its aura attacks the mind, burning away a foe's energy and leaving it a burned-out shadow of itself, yet its body is only lukewarm to the touch.
